title: The Bug That Leaves No Stack Trace
description:
Your counter went from 0 to 1. It should have been 2. No crash. No error. Just corrupted data.

In this short:

* Why race conditions happen even in “simple” code
* How counter++ becomes LOAD → ADD → STORE at the CPU level
* Why two threads can overwrite each other silently
* What mutexes actually do when a thread acquires a lock
* Why concurrency bugs are some of the hardest bugs to reproduce

No jargon. Just clear diagrams. Subscribe to SysSketch — programming systems, visualized.
